question: Partners X and Y invest Rs. 60,000 and Rs. 90,000 respectively. X works for 6 months, Y for 4 months. Profit is divided based on capital * time. Find their profit ratio.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit ratio = Ratio of investments × Ratio of time periods

Investment Ratio = 60,000 : 90,000 = 2 : 3

Time Ratio = 6 : 4 = 3 : 2

Profit Ratio = (2 × 3) : (3 × 2) = 6 : 6 = 1 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1:1.**
